judged_text: The disqus import was rewritten to call TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link]) instead of creating posts directly: the documented -c/--category option was deleted (thor errors on unknown options), threads whose link is not http(s) are silently skipped because import returns nil, and the first unreachable link raises inside open() and aborts the whole import mid-run. Operators running the previously documented `disqus import -c <category>` invocation get an unknown-option error, and anyone importing an export containing one dead or non-http link gets a partial, silently incomplete import with no report of which threads were dropped.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the Thor option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, so the previously supported `-c/--category` flag will now be an unknown option. The import logic is changed to `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`; `TopicEmbed.import_remote` calls `open(url).read` with no rescue, so the first dead/unreachable URL can raise and abort the whole run. Also, `TopicEmbed.import` returns nil unless the URL matches `^https?://`, and `disqus.thor` only continues when `post.present?`, meaning non-http(s) links are skipped without any report/logging in this code.
